summary.zh: 追问流失原因、留存口径与客成编制
summary.en: Challenge churn, retention, segmentation, and CS hiring plans.

description.zh: 在对外讲留存数字、扩充客户成功团队或重做客户分层之前，先把毛留存和净留存分开，追问客户离开的真实原因与各分群的时间价值。适合要给出留存结论或批准 CS 编制时使用。
description.en: Separates gross from net retention, names the real reason customers leave, and checks time-to-value by segment before a retention claim or CS expansion. Use it before quoting retention to the board or approving CS headcount.
